panels.title: FuboTV Hockey Stop
panels.image: A hockey player stands center ice facing the camera, body angled slightly forward, arms relaxed at his sides, mouth open mid-speech. The rink boards behind him carry bold FuboTV logos, and digital banners on the bleachers repeat the FuboTV name above a blurred cheering crowd. Cool white ice fills the foreground, with soft overhead arena lighting and a reddish-orange, white, and blue color palette. The camera sits low at ice level, framing the player from the waist up in a medium shot, rendered in a realistic cinematic promo style with shallow depth of field.
panels.motion: The FuboTV hockey player skates toward the camera, stops short, and kicks up a spray of ice mist. He then skates away from the camera.
panels.dialogue: Getting the best deal on hockey isn't a hat trick... It's just FuboTV.
